Hensikten med dette prosjektet er delt i 3 ulike formål: • Sanere vannledninger i området, og spesielt mellom Vilberg høydebasseng (HB03) og Kleiva trykkøker PV05. • Etablere tverrforbindelse for vannforsyning over Gransmarka mellom Lensbygda og Kolbu for gjensidig forsyningsmulighet, som et tiltak for å øke sikkerheten i vannforsyningen i kommunen. • Tilknytning av randsone med spredt avløp i Gransmarka-området I denne første etappen (entreprise E1) skal det etableres nytt vann- og avløpsanlegg i området fra Vilberg (HB03) til vannstasjon Kleiva trykkøker (PV05) gjennom Smebyvegen og Buskumlinna.

title: Denmark – Safety consultancy services – Managed Detection and Response (MDR)
description: Med henblik på at beskytte Statens IT (Ordregiver) mod aktuelle og fremtidige cybertrusler anvender Ordregiver en række sikkerhedsteknologier, herunder en Extended Detection and Response (XDR)-platform. XDR-platformen understøtter indsamling, korrelation og analyse af sikkerhedsrelaterede hændelser på tværs af Ordregivers it-miljø med henblik på at beskytte systemer, tjenester og data samt sikre dataenes fortrolighed, integritet og tilgængelighed. Henset hertil udbyder Ordregiver en kontrakt, hvis formål er at understøtte og styrke Ordregivers egen operative it-sikkerhed gennem levering af en Managed Detection and Response (MDR)-tjeneste fra et Security Operations Center (SOC). MDR-tjenesten skal anvende og supplere Ordregivers XDR-platform med døgnbemandet overvågning, analyse, detektion, validering, eskalering og håndtering af sikkerhedshændelser. Tjenesten skal leveres 24 timer i døgnet, 365 dage om året, og bidrage til hurtig identifikation, vurdering og håndtering af cybertrusler og sikkerhedshændelser. Tjenesteydelserne udgør et væsentligt element i Ordregivers fortsatte modnings- og udviklingsproces på cybersikkerhedsområdet med fokus på teknologi, processer, kompetencer og samarbejde på tværs af interne og eksterne interessenter. Med udbuddet ønsker Ordregiver adgang til en professionel MDR-tjeneste, der kan imødekomme Ordregivers høje krav til kvalitet, robusthed og effektivitet, samt en leverandør, der løbende kan indgå i dialog med Ordregiver om udviklingen inden for cybersikkerhed, herunder trusselsbilledet, teknologiske muligheder, automatisering, kompetenceudvikling og løbende forbedringer af sikkerhedsniveauet. Leverandøren skal gennemføre en teknisk, organisatorisk og processuel Transition Ind, der sikrer, at de løbende MDR-ydelser kan leveres fra overgang til driftsfasen. Ordregiver gør opmærksom på, at Ordregiver har indgået kontrakt med to (2) leverandører til varetagelse af Ordregivers eksisterende XDR-platform, som leverandøren skal samarbejde med i forbindelse med Transition Ind. Som led heri skal leverandøren etablere og konfigurere de nødvendige integrationer mellem Ordregivers XDR-platform og øvrige relevante sikkerhedskilder samt leverandørens værktøjer og platforme, der anvendes til kontraktens opfyldelse. Leverandøren skal levere Løbende MDR-ydelser; herunder kontinuerlig overvågning, analyse, korrelation, validering og detektion af alarmer og sikkerhedshændelser. Leverandøren skal foretage triagering og kvalificering af alarmer med henblik på at identificere reelle sikkerhedshændelser samt sikre rettidig eskalering og advisering i overensstemmelse med aftalte processer og serviceniveauer. Disse løbende MDR-ydelser omfatter herunder: • Kontinuerlig SOC-overvågning af sikkerhedsrelaterede hændelser og alarmer. • Analyse, korrelation og kvalificering af hændelser på tværs af relevante datakilder. • Identifikation, detektion og validering af sikkerhedshændelser. • Udarbejdelse, implementering og løbende optimering af detektionsregler, use cases og analysemodeller. • Anvendelse af relevant Threat Intelligence til understøttelse af detektions- og analysearbejdet. • Løbende vurdering af trusselsbilledet og dets relevans for Ordregivers miljø. • Proaktiv identifikation af potentielle sikkerhedshændelser og sikkerhedsrisici, herunder gennem Threat Hunting-aktiviteter. • Eskalering, advisering og rapportering af sikkerhedshændelser i henhold til aftalte processer og serviceniveauer. • Vedligeholdelse af eksisterende integrationer samt etablering af nye integrationer efter behov. • Optimering og videreudvikling af Ordregivers XDR-platform og øvrige sikkerhedsløsninger. • Rådgivning vedrørende udvikling og modning af Ordregivers sikkerhedsorganisation, sikkerhedsprocesser og governance. • Gennemførelse af målrettede Threat Hunting-forløb og analyser af mistænkelige aktiviteter. • Incident Response-bistand ved sikkerhedshændelser efter rekvisition fra Ordregiver, herunder analyse, afgrænsning, håndtering, afhjælpning og genopretning. • Bistand ved større sikkerhedshændelser, cyberkriser og koordination med relevante interessenter. • Sikkerhedsfaglig rådgivning og strategisk sparring om udviklingen inden for cybersikkerhed. Kontrakten omfatter desuden tværgående ydelser, herunder dokumentation, rapportering, governance, kvalitetssikring og informationssikkerhed, der leveres gennem hele kontraktperioden. Endvidere omfatter kontrakten forpligtelser ved kontraktophør (Transition Ud), der skal sikre en kontrolleret, sikker og dokumenteret overdragelse af viden, data, processer, integrationer og øvrige kontraktrelaterede leverancer til Ordregiver eller en efterfølgende leverandør.

title: Ireland – Astronomical and optical instruments – Procurement of a High-Precision Optical Ground Station (OGS) Telescope Unit for Uplink and Satellite Tracking
description: The Contracting Authority is seeking tenders for the procurement of a High-Precision Optical Ground Station (OGS) Telescope Unit for Uplink and Satellite Tracking. This procurement is being undertaken as part of Phase 2 of Ireland's QCI project (TransEuroOGS), co-funded by the European Commission Connecting Europe Facility (CEF) and the Irish Department of Culture, Communications, and Sport. The successful tenderer will be required to design, manufacture, and deliver a turnkey telescope unit encompassing the mount, optics, and control software, complying with strict technical and spatial constraints. Key Technical Requirements: Optical Configuration: Ritchey-Chretien (RC) optical design, f/10 to f/12 system, with a clear aperture of at least 700 mm. Low central obstruction is required (30 percent or lower diameter linear obstruction preferred, maximum allowable 34 percent or lower). Optical Coatings and Power Handling: Broad-spectrum reflectivity covering both visible wavelengths and the 1550 nm C-Band NIR telecommunication spectrum, biased for optimal performance at 1550 nm. Reflectance at 1550 nm must be at least 95 percent (protected gold or equivalent high-efficiency NIR coating acceptable). The secondary mirror (M2) and main aperture must handle a high-power launch beam of maximum 40W continuous wave at 1550 nm across the aperture or annulus (power density less than 3300 W per square metre on the primary mirror). Focusing Path and Clear Aperture: Must feature at least one Nasmyth focus port (more preferred). The Nasmyth focus path must be completely free of refracting optical elements (100 percent reflective optics only, with removable optics as an allowable deviation). Clear aperture path through the Nasmyth axis must be at least 60 mm diameter to support downstream Adaptive Optics relay systems. Mount and Dynamic Tracking Specifications: Alt-Azimuth Direct-Drive or equivalent performance mount with low-latency tracking dynamics supporting Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite tracking, including high-elevation passes over Zenith. Minimum Azimuth Slew Rate must be at least 5 degrees per second (faster preferred). Pointing and tracking accuracy must be less than 8 to 10 arcsec RMS during dynamic LEO passes. Fastest tracking rate must exceed 1 degree per second with fine range control below this speed. Envelope and Enclosure Compatibility: Total vertical height must not exceed 3000 mm from the base to ensure dome clearance. Maximum radial swing clearance envelope must be at most 1470 mm. The axis of elevation pivot height must ensure clearance at all pointing directions, with the pivot axis positioned no more than 155 mm below the centre of the clearance envelope (or at the centre or higher). Full CAD models and opto-mechanical layout files are mandatory upon contract award. Software, Control Interface and API: Native integration with standard open-source astronomical communication protocols (INDI / INDIGO) or ASCOM / ALPACA frameworks. Open, fully documented network API adaptable to HTTP/REST or WebSocket interfaces for automated robotic control, telemetry, and scriptable trajectory loading. Ethernet data interface and DC power supply preferred. Delivery Constraint: Unit delivery must be completed within 3 to 4 months maximum from contract signature. Please refer to the detailed Technical Specification document for full technical specifications, compliance matrices, and contractual terms.

title: Ireland – Environmental services – Provision of Water Framework Directive (WFD) Related Services 2027 and 2028-2030 Inclusive
description: The Water Framework Directive (WFD), Directive 2000/60/EC, was adopted in 2000 as a single piece of legislation covering rivers, lakes, groundwater and transitional (estuarine) and coastal waters. Its objectives include the attainment of good status in water bodies that are of lesser status at present and retaining good status or better where such status exists at present. Artificial Water Bodies (AWBs) such as canals are defined in Article 1 of the WFD as “a body of water created by human activity” and are recognised for their artificial nature and specific monitoring requirements to ensure their continued beneficial uses for navigation, recreation, environmental and amenity value. Waterways Ireland has been identified by the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) as the government body with responsibility for ensuring this monitoring is implemented. Waterways Ireland is seeking to appoint a suitably qualified service provider to undertake Water Framework Directive ( WFD) monitoring services for 2027 and for the 2028-2030 monitoring cycle. The 2027 monitoring programme is intended to bridge the gap between the commencement of the 2028 – 2030 EPA reporting cycle. The services will be undertaken at specified locations along the Royal Canal, the Grand Canal and the Shannon-Erne Waterway.

Sopimus päättyy ilman erillistä irtisanomista, kun toimittaja on toimittanut kaikki sopimuksen kohteena olevan tuotantovuoden tuotteet asiakkaalle ja molemmat sopijapuolet ovat täyttäneet kaikki sopimuksen mukaiset velvollisuutensa. Liitteen 4 kohdassa 2 on esitetty myös muut tuotantoalueet, joista yksi tai useampi voi tulla tilattavaksi sopimuksen luvussa 14 tarkoitettuna lisätilauksena. title: Finland – Technical testing, analysis and consultancy services – Rakennuksen kosteus- ja sisäilmatutkimukset, näytteiden otot ja korjaustapaehdotukset 1.3.2027 - 29.2.2028
description: Turun kaupungin konsernihallinnon hankintapalvelut pyytää tarjouksia Turun kaupungin eri palvelukokonaisuuksien rakennuksen kosteus- ja sisäilmatutkimuksista, näytteiden otosta ja korjaustapaehdotuksista ajalle 1.3.2027 (tavoite) - 29.2.2028, minkä jälkeen sopimuksia voidaan jatkaa alkuperäisin ehdoin Tilaajan kirjallisella päätöksellä kahdella (2) yhden (1) vuoden optiolla ajoille 1.3.2028 - 28.2.2029 ja 1.3.2029 - 28.2.2030. Hankinta on jaettu kolmeen (3) osa-alueeseen seuraavasti: Osa-alue 1 Rakennuksen kosteus- ja sisäilmatutkimukset Osa-alue 2 Näytteiden otot Osa-alue 3 Korjaustapaehdotukset Osa-alueessa 1 Rakennuksen kosteus- ja sisäilmatutkimukset tehdään puitesopimus kolmen (3) Toimittajan kanssa. Jaottelu perustuu kohteiden bruttoneliöihin seuraavasti: ensimmäiseksi tullut Toimittaja saa kohteiden tilauksista 50 %, toiseksi tullut Toimittaja 30 % tilauksista ja kolmanneksi tullut Toimittaja 20 % tilauksista. Tilaajan säilyttää itsellään mahdollisuuden ± 5 %-yksikön virhemarginaaliin tilausten jakamisessa koko sopimuskauden aikana. Tilausten jaottelun toteutumisen seuranta tapahtuu Tilaajan toimesta. Tilaaja sitoutuu toimittamaan kaikille kolmelle Toimittajalle kahdesti vuodessa raportin kohteiden jakautumisesta. Raportti toimitetaan sähköpostin välityksellä jokaisen Toimittajan nimetylle yhteyshenkilölle. Seurantaraportti voidaan myös käsitellä Tilaajan järjestämässä palaverissa, jos yksikin sopimusosapuoli sen katsoo tarpeelliseksi. Mikäli kohteiden jakamisessa tapahtuu isompaa hajontaa kuin virhemarginaali mahdollistaa, tulee Tilaajan esittää perustellut syyt tällaiselle tapahtumalle kirjallisesti kaikille kolmelle Toimittajalle. Tällainen tilanne voi syntyä esim. Tilaajan tarpeesta tarjota tutkimuskohdetta sen erityispiirteisiin perustuen parhaimman asiantuntemuksen omaavalle Toimittajalle. Osa-alueessa 2 Näytteiden otot ja osa-alueessa 3 Korjaustapaehdotukset puitesopimukset tehdään yhden (1) Toimittajan kanssa, jolle valitaan kaksi (2) varatoimittajaa. Varatoimittajia tullaan käyttämään edullisuusjärjestyksessä lähtökohtaisesti sellaisissa tilanteissa, joissa ensisijaisen Toimittajan toiminta on sopimuksen vastaista tai se ei pysty tuottamaan palvelua, esimerkiksi Toimittajan toimituskyvyn, resurssipulan tai vastaavien tilanteiden vuoksi.

title: Lead Designer, Architect, Conservation Architect, CDM Principal Designer and Building Safety Act Principal Designer
description: Below is a summary please refer to the Job pack for detailed information Thetford Town Council is seeking to appoint a single consultant practice to undertake the roles of: • Lead Designer; • Architect; • Conservation Architect; • Principal Designer (CDM Regulations); • Principal Designer (Building Safety Act). The successful consultant shall lead and coordinate the design for the Development Phase and prepare the project design for submission of the NLHF Delivery Phase Application. The consultant will work closely with the Project Manager, Quantity Surveyor, Structural Engineer and specialist advisers to prepare a robust and fully costed proposal capable of supporting a successful National Lottery Heritage Fund Delivery Phase application. The NLHF Delivery Phase application will be managed by the Client Team and appointed Project Manager, however, the Architect may be required to attend NLHF meetings and workshops from time to time as reasonably requested by the Client or Project Manager. Equality, Inclusion & Environmental Sustainability The project is shaped by NLHF's investment principles and Thetford's identity as a richly diverse town. Commissioned work should demonstrate: • Inclusive engagement with communities underserved by heritage; • Barrier-free access to heritage learning and opportunities; • Environmentally responsible design, including re-use and carbon impact; • Contribution to a sustainable operating model rooted in community need. Project Objectives The project objectives are to: • Remove the building from the Heritage at Risk Register; • Secure the long-term conservation of the historic fabric; • Deliver inclusive and accessible community facilities; • Support learning, heritage interpretation and skills development; • Improve environmental sustainability; • Create a financially sustainable operational model and future for the site; • Support regeneration within Thetford town centre. All submissions should sent to Susan Moore - susanmoore@thetfordtowncouncil.gov.uk

Are the six 500-gallon price-sheet lines the quantities used for evaluation, with payment only for gallons actually ordered and delivered? - Upon reviewing the Statement of Work, we identified an error in the quantity previously purchased by the field office. The intended amount was approximately 2,715 gallons used, rather than the quantity listed. We are requesting a quote for a total estimated quantity of 3,000 gallons, allocated at 1,500 gallons per year over a two-year period. Payment will be made only for the gallons actually ordered and delivered, with the total quantity not to exceed 3,000 gallons over the two-year period. - The CLINs and price sheet show a November 16, 2026 base start, while the statement of work shows November 1. Which start date controls? - We are projecting a start date of November 16th. Which award instructions control: the price-only language or the later technical and past-performance review? Are the three work examples, two references and past-performance questionnaire required? We did not find the questionnaire in the posted file. - Price is the sole evaluation factor. I believe you are referencing FAR 52.212-2, Evaluation�Commercial Products and Commercial Services, under the solicitation provisions. This provision would only apply if applicable to the procurement. Since this solicitation is based solely on price, FAR 52.212-2 would not be applicable. The file includes FAR 52.219-14 and 52.219-33. Does a below-threshold small-business exception apply to this purchase? If not, is there a nonmanufacturer waiver for the required fuel? - While the procurement is still set aside for small businesses, the two stated FAR clauses and provisions will need to remain in place without a waiver.

title: Paramaribo/Suriname Ministry of Justice and Police Body-Worn Cameras
description: INL seeks to contract a U.S. vendor to procure, ship, install, and support a small-scale body-worn camera (BWC) pilot for the Korps Politie Suriname (KPS), under the Suriname Ministry of Justice and Security (MOJS). The pilot will be based in Paramaribo. The contractor will deliver: � At least 25 operational BWCs, plus spares of at least 10% � A contractor-acquired, on-premises digital evidence management system (DEMS), with server, encrypted local backup, and supporting infrastructure, located entirely in Suriname � Cargo shipment to Paramaribo and customs brokerage support � Installation, configuration, and acceptance testing � Role-based and train-the-trainer instruction in English and Dutch � 12 months of warranty, device replacement, and local and remote support � Monthly pilot performance reporting and a final pilot report Please reach out to procurement for the complete sollicitation package.

description: For Clarity Purposes - Additional Description Details added 2026-11-03 As per the Notice of Proposed Procurement (NPP) : This procurement is set aside under the federal government Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business. For more information on Indigenous business requirements of the Set-aside Program for Indigenous Business, refer to Annex 9.4 of the Supply Manual. Therefore, this requirement is open to only Indigenous TBIPS Supply Arrangement Holders under EN578-170432 who qualified under Tier 1, under the Remote/Virtual Access region, level of expertise and for the following categories: Stream 1: Applications Services A.1 Application/Software Architect – Level 3 A.6 Programmer/Software Developer – Level 3 Stream 6: Cyber protection services C.6. Information Technology Security Engineer – Level 3 ****************************** This procurement seeks to secure specialized and advance IT Professional Services TBIPS Consultants, who have skill sets not available internally. Employment and Social Development Canada’s (ESDC) Innovation, Information & Technology Branch (IITB), requires specialized IT professional services to enhance and deliver the Canada Disability Benefit (CDB) digital solution. Application Architects, Software Developers, and Security Engineers will design, develop, integrate, test, and secure new program functionalities, APIs, and backend systems using an Agile delivery approach. Through accessibility-focused design, rigorous testing, and secure system integration, this work will streamline benefit applications, improve the accuracy and timeliness of payments, and strengthen service delivery. As a result, Canadians with disabilities will benefit from a more accessible, efficient, and reliable process for accessing financial supports.

title: Crude Oil Inventory and Pipeline Flow Monitoring Services
description: Crude oil storage levels reached a critical inflection point in 2026, shifting from the multi-decade highs observed during the early years of the pandemic to historic multi-decade lows due to severe geopolitical supply shocks. The near-total closure of the Strait of Hormuz in early 2026 removed approximately 15 million barrels per day of global supply, making storage indicators one of the most important drivers of short-term crude oil pricing. At the same time, a significant disconnect remains between declining physical inventories and paper futures markets, increasing the need for accurate and timely inventory intelligence. Crude oil inventory and pipeline flow data are critical for supporting departmental analysis and briefings, as well as monitoring energy supply and security. To better understand North American oil markets and inform policy decisions, Natural Resources Canada (NRCan) requires greater visibility into Canadian crude oil inventories and pipeline flows. Specifically, the department requires weekly reports on crude oil inventory levels in Canada’s main storage areas, as well as daily and near-real-time pipeline flow data within Canada and for exports to the United States. The work will involve monitoring crude oil inventory levels in tank farms and underground caverns in the Edmonton, Heartland, Hardisty, and Kerrobert areas. The vendor will be required to provide NRCan with weekly reports on crude oil inventory levels in Canada’s main storage areas. For oil pipelines, the vendor will provide daily reports, historical data, and online portal access to near-real-time pipeline flow data, updated at least every 30 minutes, for flows within Canada and exports to the United States. The vendor will also provide early warning of pipeline flow interruptions and shutdowns.

description: NOTICE OF PROPOSED PROCUREMENT (NPP) for Professional Audit Support Services (PASS) This requirement is for: The Office of the Information Commissioner of Canada (OIC) This requirement is open only to those PASS Supply Arrangement Holders under E60ZQ-180001 who qualified under under the National Capital Region (NCR) area for the following category: • Stream 5: External audit The requirement is intended to result in the award of one (1) contract. The following SA Holders have been invited to submit a proposal: • Anik Consultants Inc., Samson & Associés – CPA Consultation Inc., and Samson & Associates CPA Consulting Inc., in Joint Venture • ANTARES PROFESSIONAL CORPORATION • B D O Ca n a d a LLP • Deloitte LLP • Ernst & Young LLP • KPMG LLP • Lekadir LLP • Mallette S.E.N.C.R.L • MNP LLP • OXARO INC. • Pricewaterhouse Coopers LLP • SAMSON & Associés CPA/Consultation Inc. • Welch LLP Description of the Requirement: The Office of the Information Commissioner of Canada (OIC) requires the services of an independent external audit firm to perform the annual audit of its financial statements and to provide an independent auditor's report on the financial statements. The audit must be performed in accordance with the Canadian Auditing Standards (CAS) issued by CPA Canada, including any standards that may supersede or replace them during the term of the contract. The Contractor must maintain its independence throughout the engagement in accordance with applicable professional standards and rules of professional conduct. Security: There are security requirements associated with this requirement. Please note that SA Holders do not need to have the required clearance to submit a bid. For additional information, consult Part 6 - Security, Financial and Other Requirements, and Part 7 – Resulting Contract Clauses. For more information on personnel and organization security screening or security clauses, Bidders should refer to the Contract Security Program of Public Works and Government Services Canada (http://www.tpsgc-pwgsc.gc.ca/esc-src/introduction-eng.html) website. Level of Security Requirement: Minimum Corporate Security Required: RELIABILITY STATUS Minimum Resource Security Required: RELIABILITY STATUS Applicable Trade Agreements: Canada-Chile Free Trade Agreement (CCFTA), the Canada-Colombia Free Trade Agreement (CColFTA), the Canada-Panama Free Trade Agreement (CPanFTA), the Canada-Honduras Free Trade Agreement, the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA) and the Canada-Korea Free Trade Agreement (CKFTA) Proposed period of contract: The proposed periods of contract: • Initial contract period: From contract award to October 31, 2027. • Option period 1: From November 1, 2027 to October 31, 2028. • Option period 2: From November 1, 2028 to October 31, 2029. Contracting Authority Information: File Number: P2700051 Contracting Authority: Simon Cousineau Phone Number: 343-548-3212 E-Mail: simon.cousineau@chrc-ccdp.gc.ca Inquiries: Inquiries regarding this Request for Proposal (RFP) requirement must be submitted to the Contracting Authority named above. RFP documents will be e-mailed directly by the Contracting Authority to the Qualified Supply Arrangement Holders who are being invited to bid on this requirement. BIDDERS ARE ADVISED THAT “CANADABUYS.CANADA.CA” ” IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR THE DISTRIBUTION OF SOLICITATION DOCUMENTS. The Crown retains the right to negotiate with any supplier on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language. Debriefings: Bidders may request a debriefing on the results of the bid solicitation process. Bidders should make the request to the Contracting Authority within 15 working days from receipt of the results of the bid solicitation process. The debriefing may be in writing, by telephone or in person. NOTE: Professional Audit Support Service (PASS) Method of Supply is refreshed on a quarterly basis. title: Technical Specifications (TS) for Tree Well Design in Urban Hardscapes
description: The purpose of this RFP is to award a contract to a supplier to develop a TS that will define the core concepts for urban tree wells by providing practical guidance on design approaches and material selection that build healthy and thriving urban trees. It is intended to support practitioners in planning, constructing, and maintaining tree wells that enable urban trees to reach their full growth potential, improving their ability to deliver ecological, social, and economic benefits across communities with varying space constraints.

title: SEZ, INNOMOTICS Drásov – pokračování sanačních prací
description: Předmětem plnění jsou sanační práce, které se zaměřují výhradně na jihozápadní část areálu společnosti Innomotics, s. r. o. v Drásově a na zdroj kontaminace pod výrobní halou D. Sanační zásah je koncipován tak, aby primárně omezil transport kontaminace na odtokové linii na jihozápadní hranici areálu. V rámci přípravných prací je plánováno vybudování tří aplikačních vrtů v jihovýchodní části areálu a čtyř vrtů v jihozápadní části areálu na předpokládané privilegované cestě mezi vrty MV-5 a APC-9. Cílem prací je zajistit plnění cílových limitů uložených výše citovaným rozhodnutím ČIŽP OI Brno č. j. ČIŽP/47/2025/4569 ze dne 26. 4. 2025, konkrétně cílové limitní koncentrace pro ClE v podzemní vodě stanovené pro hranici areálu.

title: Perustietotekniikkapalveluiden hankinta - Osallistumispyyntö
description: Perustietotekniikkapalveluiden hankinta - Osallistumispyyntö Jyväskylän kaupunki (jäljempänä "Hankintayksikkö" tai "Tilaaja") järjestää hankintalain (1397/2016) mukaisen tarjouskilpailun perustietotekniikkapalveluiden hankinnassa. Hankintayksikkö pyytää ehdokkaita lähettämään osallistumishakemuksen kilpailulliseen neuvottelumenettelyyn tämän osallistumispyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankinnan kohteena ovat seuraavat perustietotekniikkapalveluiden palvelukokonaisuudet: 1. Käyttäjätukipalvelut, jonka sisältämät palvelut ovat tarpeen tietoteknistä ympäristöä käyttävien henkilöiden IT-ongelmien ratkaisemiseksi, käytön neuvonnaksi ja työntekemisen tukemiseksi; 2. Päätelaitteiden elinkaaripalvelut, joka sisältää kattavan joukon palveluita varmistamaan työasemien ja mobiililaitteiden ja niiden lisälaitteiden tehokkaan, turvallisen ja kustannustehokkaan käytön niiden koko elinkaaren ajan. Kokonaisuus sisältää myös työasemalaitteiden hankinnan; 3. Palvelinten käyttöpalvelut, jonka sisältämät palvelut ovat keskeisiä palvelininfrastruktuurin ja sitä tukevan tietoliikenneinfrastruktuurin osalta ja joiden avulla varmistetaan palvelinten tehokas ja luotettava toiminta sekä hallinta; 4. Pilvipalvelut, jonka sisältämät palvelut tarjoavat julkisten pilvipalveluiden keskitetyn hallinnan ja valvonnan pilvipohjaisille resursseille ja palveluille; 5. Tietoturvapalvelut, joka sisältää kattavan joukon palveluita, joiden tavoitteena on suojata tietoteknistä ympäristöä kaikenlaisilta uhilta ja riskeiltä, sisältäen mm. ennaltaehkäisevät toimenpiteet, aktiivisen seurannan, tunkeutumisen havaitsemisen ja reagoinnin sekä jatkuvan tietoturvatason parantamisen; 6. Identiteetin- ja pääsynhallinta, joka sisältää palveluita, jotka keskittyvät henkilöstön, kumppaneiden, tietojärjestelmien identiteettien, pääsynvalvonnan ja oikeuksien hallintaan sekä niitä tukevien tietojärjestelmien ja julkisten pilvipalveluiden hallintaan; 7. Asiantuntijapalvelut, sisältävät erikoistuneeseen ammatilliseen asiantuntijatyöhön ja konsultointiin liittyvät palvelut, jotka tukevat IT-infrastruktuuria, tietojärjestelmiä, tietoturvan ja toiminnan suunnittelua, optimointia, kehittämistä, laajentamista sekä uudistamista; sekä 8. Palvelunhallinta, joka sisältää hankittavan palvelukokonaisuuden hallintaan ja kehittämiseen liittyvät palvelut sekä IT-prosesseihin liittyvät palvelut. Perustietotekniikkapalveluiden kokonaisuuksien sisältö on alustava ja tarkentuu neuvotteluissa. Hankintaa koskevat asiakirjat ja niiden sisältö täydentyvät hankintamenettelyn aikana ja lopullinen hankinnan kohde ja vaatimukset esitetään lopullisessa tarjouspyynnössä. Perustietotekniikkapalvelut on tarkoitus hankkia (1) yhdeltä, tämän kilpailutuksen perusteella valittavalta toimittajalta. Tarkemman kuvauksen hankinnasta löydätte liitteestä 1 (Hankekuvaus).,
